div.p: The text of this papyrus was OCRed from the print edition and encoded for entry during the workshop Exploring Digital Coptic Papyrology, funded by the FoF 3 of the University of Heidelberg (gefördert im Rahmen der Exzellenzstrategie von Bund und Ländern). The workshop was a collaborative effort between Eliese-Sophia Lincke, FU Berlin and Loreleï Vanderheyden, Institut für Papyrologie, Heidelberg. Access to eScriptorium at the Universitätsbibliothek, Heidelberg, as well as support during the workshop was provided by Gustavo Riva. Participants came from the Universities of Cambridge, Heidelberg and Münster.
